simple.meaning: בְּדַר (bᵉdar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to scatter.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 4:11. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּדַר (H921) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בְּדַר (bᵉdar) / H921 is traced through Daniel 4:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H921. bedar [ בְּדַר ] verb Pa`el scatter (so ᵑ7 Syriac; Biblical Hebrew [ בָּוַר ]); — Imperative masculine plural וּבַדַּ֫רוּ Dan 4:11 (accusative of thing).
